name: Report to Anastasia

meta.start: Uthel'nay, Cain Firesong, Thurston Xane, or Un'Thuwa

summary: Horde mages from across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms are called to the Undercity. Anastasia Hartwell has sensed an unknown magical disturbance there and needs capable spellcasters to investigate.

sections.title: A Call to the Arcane
sections.body: Horde mages hear of trouble in the Undercity. Those studying atop the bluffs of Thunder Bluff, in the dusty heat of Durotar, or among the ruins of Lordaeron receive the same call if they have enough skill. The Undercity's mages have sensed an unexplained disturbance within their domain and need help investigating it.

sections.title: The Mage of the Undercity
sections.body: Anastasia Hartwell oversees arcane matters in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. She confirms that mages have detected strange energies within the city. No one knows whether the magic is harmless or hostile. Anastasia needs a capable mage to investigate quietly, beginning in the Apothecarium.

faq.answer: Anastasia Hartwell is a Forsaken mage and arcane mentor in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. She guides new practitioners and watches for arcane disturbances in the Forsaken capital.
Anastasia Hartwell is in the Magic Quarter, in the northern arc of the Undercity. She is among the spellcasting trainers and arcane researchers.

faq.q: Why are mages from Thunder Bluff or the Barrens being summoned to the Undercity?
faq.answer: The Undercity's mages have detected an unusual disturbance, and Horde interests in Lordaeron may be at risk. Mentors in Kalimdor send promising pupils there to help and gain experience with complex magical phenomena.

faq.q: What kind of disturbance is Anastasia investigating?
faq.answer: Mages have detected unexplained magical fluctuations within the Undercity. Anastasia Hartwell does not yet know whether the energy is hostile, accidental, or harmless, so she begins a careful inquiry.

Horde mage trainers can send you to Anastasia once you have enough experience. They include Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar, Thurston Xane in Thunder Bluff, Cain Firesong in Brill, and Un'Thuwa in Sen'jin Village.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Anastasia?
aliases: next quest after report to anastasia
faq.answer: After you speak with Anastasia and receive her briefing, she directs you to investigate the disturbance in the city's Apothecarium, beginning with Investigate the Alchemist Shop.

angles.text: As a Horde mage, you leave your regional training outpost for the Undercity, where deeper arcane mysteries and hazards lie beneath the ruins of Lordaeron.
The call brings Forsaken and other Horde mages together to protect their shared interests.
As Forsaken, you are called to the Undercity's Magic Quarter to help guard your young kingdom against arcane threats within its walls.
